136211.overview: Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation: Hiragana Katakana Kakechatta! is an educational Pokémon game for SEGA Pico. It is designed with the purpose of teaching Japanese children to write in both hiragana and katakana. Team Rocket disguise themselves to trick Ash, Brock, May, and Max into catching more Pokémon. Pokémon are caught by correctly drawing Japanese symbols. The player is shown a symbol being drawn, then they must trace the character over a template on the screen using the Pico's pen controller. Pokémon are caught for every five kana.

136212.overview:
Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation: Minna de Pico Pokémon Waiwai Battle! is the third and final Pokémon game for the SEGA Pico. As the title suggests, it is based on the Advanced Generation series of the Pokémon anime. Ash Ketchum and Team Rocket compete in various minigames, such as racing and destroying boulders to free trapped Pokémon.

The game was bundled with a special gamepad controller.

147020.overview:
A Year at Pooh Corner is a Sega Pico game based on the Winnie the Pooh franchise. This is likely the most common game for the system, having been bundled with Pico console from launch. An Edutainment title based on the Winnie the Pooh characters of A. A. Milne. Game play consists mostly of mini-games, which are divided into themes based upon the four seasons.

Spring - Pooh's Spring Cleaning - Objects are blown around Pooh's house and you must show him where they belong. - Pin the Tail on Eeyore - Eeyore has lose his tail, help him put it back on. - Piglet Grows a Garden - Water Piglet's Garden to grow Plants and Flowers

Summer - Pooh's friends will show you questions, Use Pooh to collect the correct answers from the river.

Fall - Move Pooh to the Honey tree. Once inside you find yourself in the Honeycomb Maze. Get to the other side by stepping on as many honeycombs as possible while avoiding the flashing honeycombs.

Winter - Trace the letters, numbers and shapes pooh's friends ask for on the frozen lake - Build your own snowman

Also includes a make your own video option, with music, backgrounds, characters, and drawing tools. Click the clock and the characters become animated.

147024.overview: Bakuryuu Sentai Abaranger immerses you in the world of brave Sentai warriors! In this gripping game, you'll fight alongside the brave Abarangers against terrible enemies. The action-packed levels require teamwork and strategic thinking as you battle evil. With impressive skills and exciting challenges, this adventure provides hours of fun. Join the Abaranger team and fight evil to save the world!

147027.overview: Denji Sentai Megaranger (電磁戦隊メガレンジャー) is a Sega Pico game based on the Denji Sentai Megaranger television show.

147064.overview:
Gekisou Sentai Carranger is based on the Japanese Super Sentai television series. The game features interactive storytelling where players engage in various mini-games and educational activities. It leverages the Sega Pico's interactive book interface, allowing children to turn pages and use a stylus to interact with the game's elements. The narrative follows the Carranger team as they combat the villainous Bowzock gang.

The gameplay includes solving puzzles, coloring activities, and simple action sequences, aimed at educating and entertaining young players. The game's educational focus is designed to be engaging for children, utilizing the popular characters and themes from the Gekisou Sentai Carranger series.

147117.overview:
In "Ninja Sentai Hurricanger & Hyakujuu Sentai Gaoranger Chou Sentai Super Battle," players engage in an action-packed crossover of two Super Sentai series: Hurricanger and Gaoranger. The game follows the narratives of both series, bringing together the ninja-themed Hurricangers and the animal-themed Gaorangers to confront a new threat. Players can experience storylines and scenarios inspired by the TV shows, featuring familiar characters and iconic battles.

The gameplay involves side-scrolling beat 'em up mechanics, where players can choose their favorite Sentai heroes from both teams. Each character has unique abilities and attacks, reflecting their skills and powers from the series. The game includes various levels filled with enemies and bosses, requiring players to use strategic teamwork and character-switching to overcome challenges. Special moves and combination attacks enhance the gameplay, providing dynamic combat experiences.

147129.overview:
Packet 2: Yukai na Nakama to Game de Kazuasobi (パケット２ ゆかいな仲間とゲームで数遊び) is a Sega Pico game and sequel to Yukai na Mori no Packet. It originally shipped with some plastic toys.

As with the previous, cartridge of this game is built-in microphone, it has become possible to operate by the speech recognition for some operations.

147130.overview: Paddington no Sekai Ryokou (パディントンのせかいりょこう) is a Sega Pico game themed around Paddington Bear.

147131.overview: Pecola no Daibouken Maboroshi no Ice Cream o Sagase! (ペコラのだいぼうけん まぼろしのアイスクリームをさがせ！) is a Japanese-only Sega Pico game based on the Pecola anime series.

147132.overview: Pepe's Puzzles is a puzzle game created for small children between the ages of 5-7 years old. There are three different kinds of mini-games found in this game; Mazes, Puzzles, and Sequential Memory/Matching Games. There are 5 different mazes to choose from, all with their own gimmicks. The main goal in the maze mini-games is to get to the flag, but each mini-game involves a different way to do so. One is simple movement, one is following arrows, one is a specifically colored path, one involves picking up all the fish food before reaching the flag, and one has X or O spaces on the maze. There are two different puzzles to choose from; a slide puzzle and a jigsaw puzzle. There are bad penguins that should be avoided in both puzzles. There are 4 different matching/memory games to choose from. One is simply matching fish, one is remembering the correct pathways by color, one has you turn the pages of the book to find an object, and one has you match the colored shapes in order. There are 2-3 difficulty levels depending on the mini-game, and it primarily focuses on teaching problem-solving and logic skills.

147135.overview: Petapeta Chokkin Asoberu Zukan: Doubutsu (ぺたぺたちょっきん あそべるずかん <どうぶつ>) is a Sega Pico game.

147137.overview: Peter Pan Neverland e Ikou! (ピーターパン ネバーランドへ いこう!) is a Sega Pico game themed around Disney's 1953 animated film, Peter Pan

147138.overview: Pico Soccer Mezase Soccer Senshu (ピコサッカー めざせサッカーせんしゅ) is a Sega Pico game.

147152.overview:
Disney's Pocahontas Riverbend Adventure is described as storyware and it based on the 1995 animated Disney film. It offers several activities in the universe of the Indian princess:
Music: create your own tunes to make Pocahontas dance.
Geometry: create pottery using different shapes.
Coordination: a little arcade game with a canoe on the river, Pocahotas should doge objects.
Pairing: find different clothes to recreate Percy's suits.
Drawing/count: use the pico pen to link numbered dots to reveal a picture.

147154.overview: A Nintendo franchise has come to a SEGA console. Pocket Monsters: Sūji o Tsukamaeyou! is an educational game for younger players, based directly on the Pokémon anime series. Taking place late in the Johto saga, Ash Ketchum (or here, Satoshi) is traveling with Misty (Kasumi) and Brock (Takeshi). As usual, Team Rocket is following, and they attack, stealing all their Pokémon except for Pikachu and Togepi. The player must recover the lost Pokémon through a series of minigames, most of them math related. The game features voice acting from the anime's cast.

147160.overview: Pooh-san no Hajimete no Eigo (プーさんの はじめてのえいご) is a Sega Pico game themed Winnie-the-Pooh.

147163.overview: Pooh-san no Ichinichi (プーさんのいちにち) is an educational game for the Sega Pico.

147165.overview: Professor Pico and the Paintbox Puzzle is a Sega Pico game. It is likely the only Pico game exclusive to Europe, though such is the state of Pico documentation, it cannot be confirmed if there are others.

147222.overview:
Disney's The Lion King: Adventures at Pride Rock is based on the 1994 Disney animated film. It offers several activities in Simba's universe:
Use memory skills to create a picture with puzzle pieces.
Uncover a picture and learn your ABC.
Match and learn shapes and put them in their place.
Count stars in the sky and learn numbers.
Develop your dexterity in an easy arcade mini-game

147224.overview: Tokusou Sentai Dekaranger (特捜戦隊デカレンジャー) is a Sega Pico game based on the Tokusou Sentai Dekaranger television show.

147427.overview: Plarail Pico: Plarail de Asobou! (プラレール・ピコ プラレールであそぼう！) is a package for the Sega Pico, containing a Plarail Pico console and the game, Plarail de Asobou! (プラレールであそぼう！), which was not sold separately.
